review_comments.body: **Required checks are missing** This changes the parameter lookup on the request path, but omits two checks required by `AGENTS.md`: a benchmark with before-and-after timing and allocation results, and a provider-harness case for changes visible to clients. Both requirements must be satisfied before merging. Add a `Benchmark*` in an existing test file and record the `-benchmem` results. Add harness cases that check required tool calls through Chat Completions and Responses. The new Go test checks only Chat Completions; it does not show that tools survive the full HTTP path. **File Used:** `AGENTS.md` ([source](https://github.com/maximhq/bifrost/blob/7a5dd61c894119e6a3677968b838a2d673b7c980/AGENTS.md)) Note: If this suggestion doesn't match your team's coding style, reply to this and let me know. I'll remember it for next time!

Full details: Linked Issues check
**Explanation** [`#9356`] The PR fixes the reported case. In plugins/compat/main.go, supportedParametersFor(provider, model) checks the provider-qualified key (openrouter/openai/gpt-6-luna) first. markReasoningWithToolsForResponses also uses it. The datasheet store (framework/modelcatalog/datasheet/store.go) performs an exact raw-key lookup, so this order selects the OpenRouter chat row when both rows exist. The added test TestDropParamsPrefersProviderQualifiedRow covers this case for Chat Completions only. [`#9356`] Issue requirement 2 is not met. The issue requires that a bare fallback row match the request provider and its mode/endpoints, and that a Decisions-only row not govern chat or Responses. The PR keeps the bare-key fallback unconditional. The second case of the new test asserts the opposite: a bare Decisions-only openai/gpt-6-luna row still drops tools for an OpenRouter request. The issue's regression case (conflicting Decisions-only bare entry, matching provider entry absent, must not be used) is therefore not implemented. The PR states this limitation itself. [`#9356`] Suggested coverage is also incomplete. No new test covers the Responses endpoint, native Decisions requests, or unknown-model behavior. Existing tests may cover some of these, but the PR does not establish it. **Resolution** Restrict the bare-key fallback in supportedParametersFor. Use the bare row only when its provider matches the request provider and its mode or supported endpoints fit the request type (chat or Responses). Otherwise return nil so no allowlist applies. This needs the catalog to expose each row's provider and mode/endpoints through the parameters index. The PR notes that the plugin pins a released framework, so this may require a framework change first. Update the second test case to assert that a Decisions-only bare row does not drop tools. Add tests for the Responses endpoint, native Decisions requests, and unknown-model behavior.
